# BDITEC

> Hamburg agency for web design, development, digital marketing, hosting, mobile apps, and offline marketing.

Primary public site: https://weweb-weld.vercel.app
(Contact domain bditec.com is used for email; custom web domain may change later.)

## Public pages
- / — marketing home, multilingual (de/en/ar), self-service booking
- /shop.html — agency package shop (catalog start amounts; soft-launch may use demo checkout)
- /shop.html?service=web-hosting&package=care — Care (Wartung, hosting separate) €59/mo orientation
- /shop.html?service=web-hosting&package=care-pro — Care Pro €99/mo orientation
- /shop.html?service=digital-marketing&package=sea — SEA Start (hour-capped) €299/mo; ad spend separate
- /shop.html?service=digital-marketing&package=seo-pflege — SEO Pflege €490/mo orientation
- /shop.html?service=digital-marketing&package=social — Social retainer €499/mo orientation
- /services/*.html — service detail pages
- /impressum.html — legal notice (draft)
- /datenschutz.html — privacy (draft)
- /order.html — post-checkout briefing (noindex)

## Checkout
- Server-validated totals via POST /api/create-checkout
- Demo mode when STRIPE_SECRET_KEY is unset or not a usable secret (sk_test_ / sk_live_)
- Stripe Customer Portal via POST /api/create-portal-session when a usable secret is configured

## Notes for agents
- Do not invent live prices, contracts, or delivery SLAs beyond published catalog copy.
- Prefer German default locale; respect ?lang=en|ar.
- Authenticated app surfaces: none (public marketing site only).
